authorization: User requested a nonlinear graph showing the association in the underlying observations, rather than the straight-line rescaling.
status: exploratory sensitivity alongside unchanged primary v6.2 estimator
sample: Exactly the existing 11 Phoenix and 5 Atlanta 2023 paired native-cell frames; no new acquisitions or year expansion.
cells_and_controls: Existing complete paired native-cell frames, unit weights, block intercepts and all six original context terms; no solar-geometry or VPD adjustment added.
shape: Restricted cubic regression spline with four knots; linear canopy term plus two nonlinear terms. No monotonicity, sign, curvature, plateau or significance constraint.
knot_rule: One knot set per city: arithmetic mean across its passes of the 0.05, 0.35, 0.65 and 0.95 canopy quantiles. Freeze numeric values using canopy alone before fitting; tied knots mean non-estimable, not an outcome-driven alternative.
plot_domain: For each city, intersection of pass-specific canopy P05–P95 intervals. All eligible observations, including tails, remain in the fit. This is a display range, not an inclusion gate.
reference: Each city's lower display endpoint; label explicitly. All curves and fitted linear comparisons are differences relative to that canopy level.
display_grid: 201 equally spaced canopy values over the display interval, plus every integer percentage of canopy in that interval.
bins: 20 equal-width bins over the display interval; preserve empty bins and counts, no minimum-cell or minimum-block gate.
raw_view: Per-pass binned observed LST after subtracting that pass's overall mean. Equal-pass means by bin; counts and number of contributing passes are shown in data. This adjusts only pass temperature offsets, not spatial confounding.
adjusted_view: Per-pass spline canopy-component differences, with binned partial residuals after fitted block and context adjustment. Equal-pass mean curve; show individual pass curves or their min–max range. This descriptive aggregation is not a time model or season-standardized city comparison.
spatial_uncertainty: 1000 whole-8km-spatial-group bootstrap draws per pass, seed 20260930; identical draws for both outcomes. Verify each original block is wholly nested in one resampling group. Export per-pass pointwise percentile intervals. Across-pass range is not a confidence interval; do not combine per-pass uncertainty as independent city replicates.
support: Record unique physical cell IDs, canopy distributions, bin counts, contributing blocks, and number of blocks spanning the reference and each displayed canopy value. No support gate is selected using outcomes.
primary_comparison: Existing disclosed linear LST slopes shown at the same reference and range as a descriptive comparison.
output_release: User-requested LST curves and binned observational summaries may be displayed; store full fitted coefficients and bootstrap arrays in a new sealed output directory. Do not open prior sealed time comparisons or robustness effects. Emitted-energy fits retained internally with matched design; no scale-agreement ruling.
verification: Network-free known-answer checks for nonlinear basis, linear and curved recovery with block/context confounding, paired resampling, duplicate cells, block nesting, units and reference subtraction; verify existing linear estimates on the same cells.
prior_effect_access: 2023 linear gradients already disclosed; this cannot be called a blinded confirmatory analysis. Numeric nonlinear results have not been inspected before this design record.
